[Edit](https://startupmap.iamsterdam.com/companies/wearable_technologies_1/edit/info)

Wear-Tech operates in the elder care market, providing innovative solutions aimed at enhancing personal health, safety, and independence for seniors. The company's core product, Companion, utilizes proprietary technology to scan the environment and alert both the user and their care network if potential hazards are detected. This system is particularly beneficial in situations where seniors may not be able to press a help button, as it features hands-free fall detection and can automatically initiate emergency protocols if distress is detected. Wear-Tech primarily serves elderly individuals and their caregivers, offering a smarter way to manage wander risks and ensure safety. The business model revolves around selling these advanced safety devices and potentially offering subscription-based services for ongoing monitoring and support. Revenue is generated through the sale of the Companion device and associated services.

Keywords: elder care, fall detection, hazard alerts, safety technology, senior independence, emergency protocols, proprietary technology, hands-free, wander management, personal health.
